newsitem.title: USA: Templeton Global to stay closed-end fund.
newsitem.headline: Templeton Global to stay closed-end fund.

text.p: Templeton Global Governments Income Trust said Wednesday that stockholders at its annual meeting voted to reject a shareholder proposal to convert it to an open-end investment company, from a closed-end management investment company.
The company said shareholders also voted to approve the election of trustees and the selection of the trust's independent public accountants.

The trust is designed for investors seeking a high level of current income consistent with the preservation of capital through investing in debt securities of government entities of various nations throughout the world.
